title: Español
subtitle: Accessible Pan-Hispanic Language Academy
description: A 36-week, 180-section, offline-first Spanish course targeting an ILR 2 core with ILR 2+/2+/2 stretch preparation.

content.heading: Avoid the single-story trap
content.body: Treat country, region, age, relationship, and setting as variables. Describe the evidence you have without turning one example into a universal rule.

content.heading: Cultural lens
content.body: Intercultural competence means observing, asking, adapting, and avoiding claims that one community represents all speakers.

content.heading: Avoid the single-story trap
content.body: Treat country, region, age, relationship, and setting as variables. Describe the evidence you have without turning one example into a universal rule.

content.heading: Language variation
content.body: Recognize regional choices and ask what a form means locally. Use the neutral course model for production until the situation gives you a reason to adapt.

content.heading: Reflection
content.body: Compare this context with one you know. Name one similarity, one difference, and one question that would prevent an assumption.
